name: Wyre Local Plan (2011-2031) (incorporating partial update of 2022)

housing-numbers.notes: Housing requirement varies by period: 479 dwellings per annum 2011-2019, then 296 dwellings per annum 2019-2031. Allocated housing from policies SA1, SA3 and SA4. Committed housing includes completions (4,239) plus sites with planning permission (691+295+3,068=4,054). Windfall allowance applies from 2025/26 at 50 dwellings per annum for 6 years.
